name: Etapp 2: Forsvik - Mölltorp
description: Forsvik / Göta kanal sluss to Mölltorps hembygdsgård / Mölltorps kyrka. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
utilities: Mölltorps Pizzeria / former Mölltorps Grillen context (food)
waterSources: Forsvik sluss / guest harbour water and toilet: Managed Forsvik lock/guest-harbour service cluster. Göta kanal lists toilet and drinking water; the official stage PDF says there is a drinking-water tap by the lock bridge.
notes: Official stage headline is 13 km. Naturkartan direct assembled line is about 11.9 km; Naturkartan via Skackastugan/Bergsudden is about 13.3 km. PDF segment distances produce about 12.6 km direct or 14.4 km via Bergsudden. Import must explicitly model direct vs alternate rather than flattening into a single unclear line.

Official PDFs and Naturkartan/GMaps linework support ending near Mölltorps hembygdsgård/kyrka at about 58.493837, 14.405358. OSM relation 1173504/E1 stage 10.02 end about 0.4 km earlier and assign the terminal leg to the next stage. Do not import raw OSM relation boundaries.

Stage PDF still lists a Vaberget lookout tower, but 2015/2016 Karlsborg municipal documents say the former summit tower was removed and no current rebuild evidence was found. Use Klinten as current viewpoint; suppress tower as facility.
Skaraborgsleder stage PDF says 3.3 m level difference; Göta kanal official page says 3.5 m fall height. This affects descriptive text only, not route import.

Older official PDFs list some service names that have changed or may be temporarily closed. Verify commercial services such as Forsviks Café & Mat, Villa Göta/Sköna Rum and Mölltorps Grillen/Pizzeria at integration time.
Official sources mention one shelter near Skackastugan/Bergsudden, while shelter-map/field sources indicate multiple shelters. Dedupe/cluster before import.
